name: Tom Evans
quality: small; cropped from a group photograph at the native resolution of the digitised page, no upscaling
why: Executive Committee photograph on p. 154 of the 1968 Talisman, the left-hand page of the Associated Students committee spread. The caption names seven and exactly seven people stand in one straight line, so the names map one to one. Evans is named fifth and is the fifth person from the left. The left-to-right reading is proved by this caption itself rather than assumed: the two women are named third and fourth, and the line runs man, man, woman, woman, man, man, man, which a right-to-left reading would put at positions four and five. The same page spread carries Rules and Elections (man, woman, man) and Student Activities (woman, man, man, woman), both consistent. This archive already publishes Susan Streible from the fourth position of this same line.
caption_quote: EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE—Larry Heishman, Bill Straeffer, Claudia Fowler, Susan Streible, Tom Evans, William Menser, Ron Beck.
